modelDetailText:
MODEL TRANSPARENCY

Model metrics
Close

These are model-level validation metrics, not patient predictions.

Thresholds and served probabilities

Each target has its own decision threshold, so target labels can differ even when probabilities are equal. In the real API profile, each served vessel probability is capped at the served CAD probability; equal values alone do not show that the cap changed an output. This app displays the returned outputs without recomputing them.

Metrics supplied by the configured API; they are not independently verified here.

Matching version cardiotwin-v2.0.0 does not establish that cross-validation metrics separately validate the demo-model refit. These remain model-level metrics, not this patient’s prediction.

Accepted prediction fitting-set source: Dataset patient 20: scored by models trained without this patient

METRICS MODEL VERSION
cardiotwin-v2.0.0
VALIDATION
10 x 5-fold repeated stratified CV on fixed folds; choices made on repeats r0-r4, metrics on repeats r5-r9 only; calibration and thresholds fitted per outer fold on training patients. Accuracy, precision, recall and F1 at each target's threshold (maximum balanced accuracy, Platt-calibrated). ROC-AUC with 95% patient-bootstrap CI.
SAMPLE COUNT
303
TRAINING DATE
2026-10-10T09:22:44Z
Model validation metrics by prediction target
Metric	CAD	LAD	LCX	RCA
Accuracy	86.7%	78.1%	68.3%	66.9%
Precision	94.4%	81.1%	57.7%	54.6%
Recall	86.7%	82.0%	74.6%	73.6%
F1	90.3%	81.3%	64.6%	62.5%
ROC-AUC	93.9%	86.6%	78.4%	76.7%
ROC-AUC 95% CI	90.8%–96.2%	82.3%–90.5%	72.7%–82.4%	71.5%–81.0%
Balanced accuracy	86.8%	77.3%	69.5%	68.2%
Brier score	0.088	0.145	0.191	0.191
Expected calibration error (ECE)	0.040	0.046	0.053	0.047
CV-summary threshold (not patient threshold)	68.6%	53.7%	34.7%	35.6%
Returned estimator	Explainable Boosting Machine (EBM)	CatBoost (gradient-boosted trees)	XGBoost (gradient-boosted trees)	Stacked ensemble of 8 models (logistic regression on their outputs)

Validation-report caveats: the CAD selection has a modest selection effect, and ensemble comparisons have mild optimism. Headline per-fold mean ROC-AUC is not the pooled calibrated AUC; these results are not clinical validation or in-sample scores. The validation threshold above is distinct from each patient prediction’s returned decision threshold.
